title: CenterPoint Energy Sending 355 Mutual Aid Workers to Help Restore Power in Areas Impacted by Hurricane Isaias
text: Frontline personnel and contractors deploying to help support Florida Power & Light withexpected outages along the Florida Gulf Coast HOUSTON, Oct. 10, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- To help support customers and communities impacted by Hurricane Isaias along the Northwest Florida Coast, CenterPoint Energy crews are heading out to play an important role in helping neighboring communities recover by restoring Hurricane Isaias-related outages. Through a mutual assistance effort supporting Florida Power & Light, CenterPoint has deployed 105 line workers and released approximately 150 contractor line workers and 100 vegetation management personnel to assist with restoration efforts in Pensacola.
